payload.reason: The evidence provides a clear description of the Random Kitchen Sink (RKS) approach, including its purpose and application in natural language processing tasks.

claims.text: The Random Kitchen Sink (RKS) approach explicitly maps data vectors to a space where linear separation is possible, improving classification performance.
RKS has been effectively used for offensive language detection in social media, achieving high accuracy with various feature sets.
The RKS method provides an approximate kernel function via explicit mapping, enhancing the discriminative capability of features.
